item.title: 'Emiru' Becomes The Biggest Female Streamer On Twitch In 2026 Following 'ICE' Controversy
item.description: Emiru, real name Emily Beth Schunk, is an American Twitch streamer, YouTuber and cosplayer known for her gaming content. She began streaming League of Legends in late 2015, becoming so popular that she inspired the design of the game's character Gwen. In 2020, she joined the content creation organization Cloud9 and grew her following significantly over the next few years. item.title: Riverdale's 'Mass Seizure' Scene A Rising Reaction Meme On Stan Twitter
item.description: There Was a Mass Seizure at School refers to a promo for Riverdale season three, episode eight featuring a scene where numerous people at Riverdale High School suffer from a mass seizure after drinking water tainted by drugs, the narration voiceover saying, "There was a mass seizure at school." The promo was released in December 2018 and became the subject of memes throughout the 2020s, including as a reaction video.

item.title: Pokémon's 10th Gen Starters Are Here And They're Getting A Lot Of Mixed Reactions Online
item.description: The Pokémon Winds and Waves Starters refers to the three Pokémon Gecqua, Pombon, and Browt, water, fire, and grass type Pokémon respectively, which make up the three starter choices in the upcoming 2027 Nintendo Switch 2 video games Pokémon: Winds and Pokémon: Waves. The starters were revealed on February 27th, 2026, and inspired reactions, memes and fan content online.
